steps.text: November 23rd, 1097, 8:45 P.M.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Huff, I'm worn to the bone...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Who do these people think they are, and where do all their funny ideas come from? What in the world goes on in their heads?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Those councilors are nothing but—

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Nothing but—idiots!!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Pff.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm so sorry you have to sit there noting everything they said. You must feel like a stack of broken records...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Their proposals aren't even for the sake of the Infected. How much speaking between the lines can an institution with the final say on Infected capacity do? Are they under the impression no one has a clue what they're up to?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Whatever institution gets to call the shots, whatever standards they allot work by once their shots are called, whatever work unit gets priority for taking on Infected employees... Of course I know what's going on, it's all a game of interests.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: They haven't discussed the reality for the Infected, but they don't wrestle over what benefits who either, so what is the SENSE in them prattling on and on in circles?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: The councilors are all noble-sorts. Whether or not they'd give Infected reality any thought, they don't and won't argue about slicing the cake in open view.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: They haven't hashed out a single thing since this meeting started! Each of them has been saying Infected on loop, but they've made ZERO progress!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Everyone's denying everyone else's motions, but nobody's even pulled out a single useful solution. What ARE they producing all these proposals for?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: That's their form of contact-free war, Skyfire. Victorian city councils all go through this rigmarole before the allocation of interests they actually mean ever gets carried out.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: And then that Councilor Janeway—

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Saying he's doing it to help the Infected make more money, have more freedom of choice, live a better quality of life. Oh, he makes himself sound SO charitable.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: 'If we place no restrictions on the Infected's work hours, then they'll be free to choose their own, and that's more money in their bank.'

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Your imitation's startling.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: ...That smarmy hypocrite tone of his really makes my stomach churn!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: He knows full well just how scant Infected pay can be, and the bulk of it doesn't even land in their own pockets. And he still acts like he's been pouring his heart out for... drgh.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: He did suggest a plan of action—reconstruct the Infected neighborhood directly into a factory so all the people have work, assigned living quarters, and can provide for themselves. It's a patch on most countries' policies, you can't even argue that.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Keh!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: They're all too arrogant here.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Hm? Something else up?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Like those lords opposed to any new policy for the Infected...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Saying they want all the foreign Infected out, no matter how long they've been here, if they've settled down, if they've already adapted to life here...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: All their proposals are just about driving these people out. And then what? You want those Infected refugees running out their time in the wastelands?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Have they thought for one second about where these people at the end of their rope are going to go?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Pff.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: *Sigh* That's a council for you.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Excuse me...?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: That's a council for you.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: If anyone here was actually looking out for the Infected, then they wouldn't call it the council anymore. They'd call it an Infected aid association.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: The aim of both sides is very clear. They want to rule out the most infeasible plans in public first, then negotiate concessions with other so they can find equilibrium, and that's business as usual.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: But a lot of people have been counting on the 'White Wolf' Count to declare where he stands. I think it caught everyone off that his vote was to abstain today.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: 'White Wolf' Skamandros... He hasn't expressed any governmental viewpoint for a good half a year. And it's anyone's guess why...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: This shouldn't be... This can't be...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Ah—I was the most naive one in the whole room.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I thought there'd be a few clear heads, at the very least. Even if they're out to keep Caladon running at status quo, at least they'd bring forth a few proposals that resembled reality.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: But they're just using the council as a place to game each other. What's driving them is how they alone can profit.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Oh, you're repeating yourself, Miss Mountbelan. At least now you know they're all self-interested sorts when you go back in? The fact shouldn't shock you at this point.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Hold on, I thought you didn't drink...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: If they think this is fine, then it's all going to blow up sooner or later!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Mmm?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: One day, sooner or later, mark my words! Constant oppression, constant exploitation! How long can this hold for? Do they really not understand? Nobody wants to live this way...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Even if they only have the faintest glimmer of hope, they want to survive! They'll break their backs to survive! I know that full well!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: ...Miss Mountbelan, I think you lost the thread somewhere along the way.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: No one's born evil. No one's born stripping other people of their lives for fun... From the very beginning, they were all just Infected endeavoring to survive.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Mm—and I'm just a friend endeavoring to stop you drinking any more.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Are they just meant to settle with being inferior, tuck themselves away? Were those lords meant to be born as nobles, meant to exploit them for their own interests?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: It's a house of idiots! If none of them ever think to rein it in, the Infected are bound to revolt sooner or later...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: These ungrasped questions... everyone's lives will be destroyed...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: We can't let all the... Reunion business... happen again...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: No, we can't, and you can't take a single glass more. You've drunk plenty enough. Just leave it for a moment. Water?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: No! I was still drinking that... give me another! They won't listen to me... I'm the one in the right!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Mm... 'I'm the one in the right'...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Sticking fast to your own views is exactly why Councilor Angst fetched you.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Mm?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: A noble in isolate, with foresight and a clear mind.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: But those short-sighted Caladon old guard wouldn't comprehend him.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: They would never reform, unless their interests were damaged right before their eyes.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Is that clear enough for you, Miss Too-Much-to-Drink? I know I'll probably have to repeat myself once you sober up again.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Buhh-huh-huh-hoo...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: What are you crying for now?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: The glass... stuck to my hand! Boo-hoo-hoo...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: No it's not, no it's not, I got it off for you, I got it off. It's not stuck.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: If they're all going to be so dead wrong and still think they're so right... then this world's done for...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Oh, and she's out like a light.
November 23rd, 1097, 10:45 P.M.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Are you up? You passed out just like that in the middle of the dinner party. Even if you had me with you, that was all too careless of you.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: ...I feel sick...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: You know, I've been getting more and more fond of you.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: You're a spoiled rich lady, but your goodwill towards the Infected and the rest of the destitute ended up so genuine anyway. You know how big the problem in this city is, don't you? Do you want to change Caladon a little for the better?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: And you're well aware I'm just a recorder from the town archives at the moment. If I want to climb my way up, I need the right person. How about you and I talk some back-alley talk, you lead the fore, and I'll be right there mucking with you?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: You know Councilor Jones? The one who signed the proposal in joint with Councilor Janeway. But in reality...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Part of the money they've built the factory with gets allocated by Caladon Council, as it happens. And, well, there's a giant question mark on if all that money's actually gone to the factory.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Standard affair between Caladon's nobility, really.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: If you can think of a way to get to the bottom of this, then forcing them to compromise won't be a pipe dream!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Wow~

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: You really... know a lot!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Well, I've said my part. Now, have you heard any hearsay about? Tell me a thing or two, let's exchange information~

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I have! I have—I, I'm going to make them realize how wrong they are! I'm... the one in the right!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Brilliant...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: You're still drunk.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: (Fine background, good of heart, understands a bit of politics, but has never gotten involved in any of the practice. Still a little naivety left. Her sort usually get a nasty shock from how ruthless reality is...)

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: (She's definitely heard about how it works on paper before, but this should be her first time witnessing any Victorian legislative assembly for herself. She reckons she knows it all, but she's got a long way to travel still.)
November 24th, 1097, 9:20 A.M.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: ...Who is it?! Ugh... You know I'm off today...?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: O—Oh! Mr. Midley? Oh, I'm very sorry about that, did you need anything?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Councilor... no... Professor Angst? What's wrong with him? Sudden heart issues? Someone broke into his house last night?! Is he alright? Is he at the hospital?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Alright, alright, if he's stable then that's good. You should have told me last night... should I go to the hospital right now?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Event? You want me to attend for you? Not a problem, I'll get ready now.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I understand. Enquire after Infected opinion, make the government's stance clear. Yes, I understand.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: What in the world? Petty thieves breaking into councilors' houses...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Fine, I'm happy to go. I get to shed light on a few things I'm still curious about. Urgh... my head's still pounding from last night...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: How did I... how did I return last night...? It feels like I said so much at the dinner party. What did I tell Kite about? What did she even tell me about?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: *Sigh*... Well, first things first!
In an open area in the Infected community, a large crowd of the Infected are gathered.
A blue-blooded Member of the Council wanting to chat with them. Now there's something new.
With looks of both curiosity and doubt, they gaze at the tidily dressed girl before them.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Didn't they say that Councilor man was coming today?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Look, see what I told you? None of those old codgers would come themselves. They hardly want to get up close with us.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Fact remains they sent someone at all, though. What are they up to?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Ahem...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Not a worry, everyone, say whatever you want to say. I'll pass on all the issues you raise to Councilor Angst.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: (Whisper) You first.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: (Whisper) Why me? Why not you?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: We'll start with the man over there, then.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Eh? Me?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Yes, how long do you reckon you've been working here?

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Not more than half a year.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: ...Can't remember it now.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: So, whereabouts did you come from?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Kazimierz.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Ursus...?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Compared to before, how do you feel life is now? Is your daily workload too much?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: I don't have to risk my life down in the underground arenas, at least... Yeah, I can get by and scrape up a living. It's okay.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: They said being at this event would still count as work, and we'd still get paid. Is that true?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: That, I can assure you. After the event's over, we'll reimburse you all.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: So, have you ever had your pay docked before, or not come on time?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: You can tell me, it's alright! I wouldn't let your information slip!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I see how it is, then... I'd like to ask, your family lives about...

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Just right in this neighborhood. We're all in one bed, and they provided us bedding for the first day's wages. It's a bit thin, but we all squeeze up in the winter, so it's not that cold.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Several people in one household, I see... So are there any elderly here?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Factory won't take them on. They can't take the physical labor.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: The ones who have kids might be let in here to live, but it's hard to say. The ones without... maybe there'll be work fit for old people, and they'll accept, but that's not easy either.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Then can you tell me about your meals and pay here? Including if anyone's ever had their wages deducted?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: We eat straight in the factory. I get to eat a half-decent amount, at least. Better than working on an empty tank.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: And pay, well... hahah...

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Thing about pay is, times are, the supervisor...

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: He tells us the Originium on us rubs onto the goods, and now the product's contaminated and they can't sell it, so they won't pay us.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Those people, honestly... They do one thing and say another...

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: It's always like that. And they said recently our factory's had bad results so they won't raise our wages. And they'll drag a whole lot out at once whenever they please, hire new ones after a bit, and they get paid even less...

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: We've got no room for a say. The council won't even let us in, and not one of them listens.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Mm, that much I've noted...

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Normally, now and then we'd head to a pub close by, kick our feet up once we're off work... but this morning, they had a fire break out.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Bloody right. There's just been no end to it lately.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: A fire? The... 'Green Spark' pub?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: When did it happen? Just this morning?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: How? What about the girl running the place? Is she alright?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Ah, that we're not too sure of ourselves. The regulars there said they've been searching for her all this time, but they haven't the faintest where she's run to...

steps.name: Infected Employees
steps.text: What's happening?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*... What's going on?!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Left side, right side, by the plan! Grab them all! Go!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (An explosion? This is the scent of Originium explosives...)

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Let go of me, let go of me! What the hell are you lot doing?!

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: Wh-Who the hell are you all—

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Keep it down! Stuff their mouths!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (Infected? Why?)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (Four, six, eight, ten... this is odd, where did they all come from? Where are all the guards?)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (...What are they taking the workers for? What is it they want?)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (No, hold on... they're tying them up right in the street, no hesitation. They were clearly ready for this...)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (I need to see what this bunch intend on doing.)

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Take that girl away as well.

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: You behave.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Let go of me. I can walk by myself.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Hurry it up, move! Into the van, is that everyone? Go, take them all to the factory!

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Got them all, boss!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Shut the door! Go, go, go!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (It's been a twenty-minute journey, and they've taken turn after turns along the way. These people are on the watchout.)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (These ties are practically insulting, using material as regular as this. I could burn these to nothing in a heartbeat.)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (Now we're at... the factory? It's barren! Where are all the facilities?)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (Strange...)

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Why are you taking us?!

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: L-Let us go! We—I-I've got a family waiting for me to send money back! For Pete's sakes, let us go...!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Shh, settle down! Now stay there!

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: I'm telling you, someone'll have the police on you, kidnapping all these people in the street!

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: The sooner you let us go, the gentler they might be on you when the time comes...

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: You're pulling my leg, the police? You think that scares us?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Now shut your yaps and behave, the lot of you!

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Y—You're all Infected too! What kind of business is this?!

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: You'll be done for in the end if you carry on like this!

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: You can zip it.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: We said be-bloody-have! Okay? Keep prattling and you're done for right now!

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: I'm warning you lot, don't try anything funny with us. If I find a single one of you even thinking of any Originium Arts, I'll cave your head in, understand?

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Now be still!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (These people, honestly... This is the least creative villainy.)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (...I won't let them off easily, soon enough.)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (But just what are they up to...?)

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: What about that councilor? Where's he? Weren't we nabbing an old man? Why've we got a little miss instead?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Same difference. Old boy, young girl, it's fine as long as we have them.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (So they were coming after Councilor Angst.)

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: So what now?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: We're waiting for the signal from the rest. Just get ready for now.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Did everything end up here?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: We only took half.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Then remember, when you head back, drop past the shot building by the old border part of the city. Do away with all the bomb stuff and the chemicals. It's dangerous leaving it there. Don't let it bite us in the arse.

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Right! The safehouse and all that. I almost forgot.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: And the stuff the Danton brothers hid for getting out of the city. Make sure that's ready to go too.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: That's money, clothes, false IDs, and the essential weapons! Don't forget any of it!

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Oi, oi, take it easy, they're all listening!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: What's the matter? They're dead before they'll get to talk.

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Plonk those explosives in place, move it.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: You lot watch these Infected, we're off to work.

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Righto.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (...Are those all bombs?)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (The factory's got no machines, it's just bombs after bombs... were they all moved here?)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (It looks like I don't need to keep wasting more time.)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (Lucky I'm carrying a reserve Arts Unit, or else things would be very tricky.)
She gives her ring a rub, the black gem's surface emitting a flicker of bright light.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Hey, what happened to your ropes?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Shh, keep it down. No matter what you hear next, just stay put and don't come out.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: A... Alright...

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Someone's running for it!

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: How? Who tied the ropes?

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Oh, look at you, pretty little kitten! Thinking of scarpering on your own?

steps.name: Infected Hooligan
steps.text: Look at that waist, though, heheh. I tell you, you put that in my hands and I could—

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Honestly, you people really... sicken me...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: *Sigh*...
Boom.
The violent sound of the detonation rings through the entire factory.
Along with the raging flames of the Originium Arts and fragments of the interior walls, several hooligans fall to the ground and are knocked out.
The Originium crystals fall away from their bodies in the heat, dropping to the floor.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Were these... stuck on? No, wait, this is just glass painted black!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (Fake Infected?)

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: What the hell happened!?

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: You useless ballsacks, I told you to watch them! Some shit mess you've made!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Who got you to do this? Why are you disguised as Infected?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: No, let's be clear... you have no Infected among you at all, do you?

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: You bloody woman... not half-bad at this, are you?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: What's it matter if we do or don't?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: You're not getting out of here alive. Who's going to know the truth?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Communicating with you lot is really wearing me out...

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: What are you trying?

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Park yourself on back, now! Else I'm done playing nice!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: (It's clear they'll kill to silence, but they're still menacing us into complying using their arms. There's no logic to it at all...)

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Just try and threaten me with those weapons, go on.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: How many people like you do you think I've dealt with before?
The flames dance across the ground, drawing a brilliant show of firelight.
Piled in a corner, the resin shells of the Originium bombs melt apart in the blaze.
Their crystalline electronic components laid bare, they let out a boom.
The cores of the explosives emit blinding rays of light, then deactivate.

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: The bombs! The bombs got cooked!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Why didn't they explode? What happened?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Are you thick?! It's Originium Arts! She's a Caster!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Shit! We're in for it, now!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm giving you two choices.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: First, you surrender nicely. I've got a lot I intend on asking you, still.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm not recommending the other choice, because right now, I'm in a VERY bad mood.

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Piss off! Who do you think we are?!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Come on, boys, do her in! Do all these Infected in!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Excuse me! Did you not see those Originium Arts just now?!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: How many people in Caladon could pull off Arts of that caliber?! Are you still going to resist?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: What the hell is running through those brains of yours?!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: Yeah, and what's all the fuss?! You're just a Caster!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: I've seen a sight and a half, the places I've been! We've got Casters too! Show me what she's made of, go on!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: *Sigh* And I've had enough...

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Wait! No! We have to leg it!

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: What now?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Her! I just remembered! She's not a normal Caster!

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: It's King's Wand! She's that Mountbelan family's...

steps.name: Rough Hooligan
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ugly Hooligan
steps.text: Enough questions! Run!

A lively flame springs from the young lady's palm, its licks surging upwards. The sound of metal cracking under the sheer heat bursts forth before her, as if a gargantuan creature emerges from the blaze, awoken from its slumber.

The flames' light laps past the shattered fluorescents, flowing over the pillars, the air warped and twisting in the heat's dance. Only the flames themselves, sweeping about the debris on the factory floor, shine brighter, fiercer, more brilliantly.
The hooligans are wide-eyed and slack-jawed in terror, not daring to twitch a muscle.
Amidst this sea of chaos, the flames' tongues play gently with the ends of the lady's hair, unable to harm her in the slightest.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: ...Kneel before the flame of the heavens.
And all of it is thrown down, the resplendent red light filling their eyes, until soon enough they can see no more.
The lady brings down her two arms, held high.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: That... that was marvelous.

steps.name: Infected Citizen
steps.text: You're... incredible!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Are the others alright? Is anyone hurt?

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: We're fine, we're all fine.
The Caster turns around, intending to help up the Infected.
When from behind, a figure hidden away in a corner comes charging a her.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Shit... bloody Caster, it's you or me!

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Who's there?
From a staircase beneath the ceiling, a nimble silhouette quickly flits through the opening overhead, disappearing from Skyfire's line of sight.

steps.name: Infected Worker
steps.text: Miss Caster, are you still fine?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm alright.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Help me with the others! First things first, we all get out of here!
November 27th, 1097, 6:40 A.M.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Kidnapping Infected? Blowing up the factory?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Right, though I still can't make sense of what in the world they were trying at.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Odd indeed...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: What about those bandits you got? Did they say anything?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Things were a bit of a mess there. I might've gotten slightly heavy-handed...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Never mind. I won't ask for the details.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Disguising as Infected to bomb a factory... I do have a guess for what made them do this.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Trying to capture those few runaways might pose some difficulty.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: It's not too realistic to hope the guards look into an Infected community case, either.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: And some other things are puzzling me about this... I could swear I saw...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Forget it, let's not mind this for now. Have any of you found Miss Susie yet?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I'm sorry, but not yet. I've already sent people to search. The guards say they saw her there when it caught on fire, but she quickly ran off in tears.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'll search too if needs must... I'm a little worried for her.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mr. Root! Open the door! Mr. Root!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mr. Root! I'm begging you, save her!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: We've got an Infected who's almost gone, help us!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Susie? Mr. Red? What happened??
